resources.string:
What you type stays on this phone. Suggestions, learning and the language model run here. LocalType goes online only when you request an optional model download from Hugging Face, and that does not send your typing. Updates come through Google Play. Google’s ML Kit library, which connects to Gemini Nano, can send Google statistics about that feature’s use.

LocalType privately stores words you add, learned word pairs, recent model suggestions, recent emoji and site names from web or email addresses you typed in full. It never saves the rest of an address. It also learns each letter key’s average finger-lift offset from known words completed without correction. These offsets help choose corrections; they never change which letter a tap types. Forget learned words clears them too.

Saved text stays in a private file excluded from backups and phone-to-phone transfers. Recent copies stay in memory for at most an hour. Copies marked sensitive, or made in password or incognito fields, are never kept. Unconfirmed misspellings are not learned. Password fields get no suggestions; incognito fields save nothing you type. If you choose LocalType as the phone’s spell checker, other apps send it the text being checked; it stays on this phone and is never kept or learned.

The optional typing log records suggestions and the words you type or tap next. It stays on this phone unless you export it. Turning logging off keeps the existing file; Clear log and Forget learned words remove it.
This download needs network access. It does not send your typing.
